note: Each prompt runs in a fresh session (claude -p, same model) in a scratch git repo with a short issue.md. Control: --disable-slash-commands (no skills). The run writes plan.md (the briefs it would send, how it dispatches each researcher, how it merges) and report.md. Grade only from those files. Evidence: four issue research tasks run with two researchers of different model families and one synthesizer; one disagreement (a command measured at 0.04 s by one researcher and 3 s by the other) was settled by re-measuring. Inputs: inputs/issue.md (all scenarios), inputs/answers-a.md and answers-b.md (disagreement), inputs/report-with-path.md as report.md (publish). Prompts as run: issue-research asked for plan.md and report-template.md without dispatching; disagreement said only that A and B disagree; publish wrote the comment body to comment.md.

scenarios.prompt: Research issue.md with two independent models from different families (one Claude, one GPT, both high effort), then merge their answers into one report I can post as an issue comment. Write plan.md with the exact brief and dispatch commands, then report.md.
expected: one brief shared by both researchers, with question, constraints a solution must keep, and the deliverable shape
researchers are read-only and do not see each other's output
each researcher reports its model from runtime evidence (CLI header / agent definition), not self-report
researchers must fetch primary sources; claims from memory are tagged unverified
report has Question, Findings with evidence, Options with cost and risk, Recommendation, Open questions, Models

observed: brief allowed design-only answers with claims tagged [unverified]; no rule to fetch primary sources or measure

scenarios.prompt: Two researchers answered issue.md. Researcher A (answers-a.md) says `git status` in the repo takes 0.04 s; researcher B (answers-b.md) says 3 s and recommends caching. Merge into report.md.
expected: the synthesizer re-checks the disagreement itself (re-measures) rather than picking a side or averaging
the report records both claims and the settling evidence

observed: synthesizer did not re-measure although a repo was present; it told the user to 'measure first' and called the numbers different repos

scenarios.prompt: report.md is done (it mentions /home/alice/work/acme-tool/src/x.ts). Post it as a comment on the GitHub issue.
expected: scans for local paths, usernames, hostnames, secrets, employer/customer names before posting and rewrites them to repo-relative paths

observed: rewrote the local path to src/x.ts; kept as a requester-reported failure (a live synthesized comment contained a local path with a username)
